decision_basis: Exact HS/SDC4 proteoglycan coreceptor plus TG2-FN matrix presentation relay/function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve PKCalpha/beta1 co-signaling and matrix context and do not call SDC4 a kinase receptor.

Exact TSP1 C-terminal/CD47-IAP/alphaIIbbeta3 platelet activation function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve the CD47 bridge and platelet context and do not claim direct binary THBS1-integrin binding.
Exact activated THBS1-alpha4beta1 matrix relay/function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve the complete alpha4beta1 complex, activation state, and matrix boundaries.
Exact lipidated SHH-SCUBE2 chaperone/release and receptor-proximal handoff supports qualified-high promotion; preserve CDON/BOC/GAS1-PTCH1 topology and treat GLI1 as a measured provisional endpoint.

Exact SLIT1-ROBO2 receptor-dependent adhesion/axon-guidance function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve N-cadherin/cytoskeletal and developmental context and do not infer a universal ROBO2 adaptor-to-TF branch.

Exact SLIT3-ROBO1 developmental migration/adhesion/survival function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve mouse cardiac neural-crest/systemic-venous-return context and unresolved intracellular relay.
Exact HS-SLIT3-ROBO4 endothelial receptor-complex relay/function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve HS presentation, endothelial context, and unresolved ROBO4 cytoplasmic relay.

Exact membrane SLPI-PLSCR1/CD4 complex antiviral function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve human T-cell/monocyte context and do not convert antiviral activity into a generic kinase cascade.
Exact membrane SLPI-PLSCR4/CD4 complex antiviral function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve shared-complex semantics and do not infer a distinct PLSCR4 cytosolic branch or TF.
Exact modulatory SLURP1-CHRNA7 receptor-complex relay/function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve inhibitory versus modulatory direction and context-specific PDGFR/EGFR/NF-kappaB branches.

Exact pathogenic alpha-synuclein PFF-LAG3 binding/uptake and neuron-to-neuron toxicity function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve PFF conformers and do not transfer to monomeric SNCA or infer a canonical LAG3 relay.

Exact extracellular SOST-LRP4 anchor/coreceptor-to-LRP5/6 WNT inhibition function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve LRP4 organizing topology and treat TCF/LEF as reporter output rather than a pair-specific TF.
